row: The UC Davis Pre-Health Conference offers pre-health students from across the state of California the opportunity to learn directly from inspirational health professionals and admissions representatives. Each year, thousands come to the UCD campus to participate in the nation's largest pre-health conference. The 2016 Conference will take place on October 8. Registration for non-UCD students will open on June 10. Visit prehealthconference.ucdavis.edu for more information.
